q: The language of an SFT X (as a set of admissible words) is a regular language. The minimal deterministic finite automaton recognizing the language has states corresponding to:
opts: Follower sets: for each word w, the set of u such that wu is admissible
The periods of the periodic orbits
exp: The follower set of w is F(w) = {u : wu ∈ L(X)}. The minimal DFA states are the distinct follower sets. For an SFT, the minimal automaton is the minimal edge shift presentation—the canonical graph with vertices = follower set classes.
